Direct MicTranscriber example

This version uses Moonshine’s English Medium Streaming model and the direct microphone API. Text appears while you speak; a completed line is matched to a command after a pause. Matches are displayed only, not sent to the audio tour.

The runtime and model download from jsDelivr and Moonshine. Speech processing is local. Audio and transcripts are not uploaded or saved. The microphone opens only when you click Start; Stop, hiding this page, or leaving it releases the microphone.
